name: Aniki
source: Aniki is cold and hardly speaks or opens up to anyone. He's got a bad attitude, purposely isolates himself from everyone else, and he seems to carry a hidden dark past that shrouds him in a veil of mystery. There was a time when Aniki was a generous boy that was popular among his classmates, but now he's very harsh on himself and just as harsh on his friends.
